## Technical Lead — R39 diagnostic completed; release remains held

**DIAGNOSTIC_EVIDENCE_ACCEPTED / RUNTIME_CORRECTION_NOT_ESTABLISHED / NEVER_READY_OR_MERGE_R39**

Exact reviewed head `b01cd488c6d652129a2b8baa23b1a88b812a2111`; tree `9f8ae4884276fddd978a5f42bd4643a29d69bc97`. Run [43132314920 / #4113 / attempt1](https://github.com/Jetnity/jetnity/actions/runs/43132314920) finished **SUCCESS8/8 at2026-11-12 01:22:06UTC**. Independent source/profile reviewer `/root/ch_de_ci_reconstruction` and companion/deployment reviewer `/root/ch_de_release_gate_audit` agree on the bounded results. Agent self-review is not being treated as TL-PASS.
